properties.name: Lachine Canal
properties.detail: Begin beside the water. The canal gives this guide its first change of pace: a long view through a city usually seen block by block.

properties.name: Old Port
properties.detail: Stay with the water a little longer. Here the scale opens up, with the river on one side and the older city on the other.

properties.name: Place des Arts
properties.detail: Move into the centre of the city. Use this stop for your own photographs, recommendations, or a story about what brought you here.

properties.name: Mount Royal
properties.detail: Finish above the street grid. The mountain offers a different perspective on the places you have just explored.
